 Your submission must be uploaded, submitted, and finalized prior to the Closing Date and Time. We strongly recommend that you give yourself sufficient time and at least ONE (1) day before Closing Time to begin the uploading process and to finalize your submission.

This Request for Proposals is an invitation by the Corporation of the District of Saanich (the “District”) to prospective proponents to submit proposals for Accounts Payable (AP) Automation Software(the “Solution”) as further described in Section A of the RFP Particulars.

The District is seeking AP Automation Software to increase efficiency throughout the accounts payable process. The Solution will interface with the District’s legacy ERP system, JD Edwards (JDE), and allow for the consumption of invoice information into the system through a form of Optical Character Recognition (OCR).
